problem:
A small business collected data on the number of hours of telephone usage and the total amount (in hundreds of dollars) of the company's weekly operating expenses. This data is shown below.   

| Hours $(x)$ | **$2$** | **$2.4$** | **$2.8$** | **$3.2$** | **$3.6$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Expenses $(y)$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |

Find the line of the form $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x$ that best fits the data above. According to the model, what will be the company's weekly operating expenses if the telephone is used for a total of $4$ hours per week, assuming the trend continues?

*Hint: You can use the fact that*

$$
({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}=\frac{1}{8}[\begin{aligned}40.8 & -14 \\ -14 & 5\end{aligned}],\,{X}^{T}y=[\begin{aligned}30 \\ 88\end{aligned}],
$$

*where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector.*
